name: PdxInputGroup
description:
Groups inputs, buttons and addons into one control with joined borders, passing its size and
disabled state to its children.

members.name: size
members.description: A size its children take; the group draws none of its own, so it is not a variant axis.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: A size its children take; the group draws none of its own, so it is not a variant axis.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssStates.name: disabled
cssStates.description: `disabled`: the group and its children are disabled.
